depth_calibration.frame: registered optical camera x-right y-down z-forward
depth_calibration.limitations: Published FR1 RGB source-model research calibration, not independently measured in this environment. Pinhole image projection without Brown-Conrady correction is an approximation; native infrared extrinsics, source depth registration and vehicle calibration are not independently validated. No additional range correction is applied.

evaluation_label_policy.invalid_source: retain sensor rows, mark all references and accuracy invalid, report evaluation_label_failure and exit2; never normalize, deduplicate or subset invalid labels

freeze.evidence_scope: same previously evaluated180-frame room recording; pyramidal optical-flow tracking calibration variant; all images and reference labels viewed; no new-recording or fresh-generalization claim

feature_policy.descriptor: intensity-centroid oriented deterministic256bit BRIEF on5x5binomial blur
feature_policy.detector: fixed original FAST-9 threshold20 radius3, deterministic NMS,32pixel tile max2
feature_policy.matching: detected FAST/BRIEF features reseeded only on accepted references; pair correspondences from fixed pyramidal tracking, without descriptor matching

freeze.freeze_preparation: metadata only; RGB/depth/mocap raw bytes are not read, features not extracted and registration not run

ground_truth_interpolation.method: linear translation and shortest-arc quaternion SLERP

json_metadata_audit.scope: source-manifest versus parsed freeze/report derived gap only; source SHA, acquisition timestamps and indices remain exact; no sensor association or fit gate change

optical_flow_policy.attempts: track all original previous features in extraction order, maximum400; independent forward and backward zero-coarse initialization, fixed3level9x9 measured grayscale tracking
optical_flow_policy.correspondence_selection: first maximum256 valid measured depth pairs in original previous feature order after flow/depth gates; retain every later endpoint/depth witness with correspondence_selected:false
optical_flow_policy.depth: unchanged all-nine-pixel validity/range/spread gate; sample depth and backproject rounded integer pixel; refinement observes measured LK subpixel endpoint
optical_flow_policy.endpoints: accepted flow endpoints in original previous-feature order, distinct buffer with subpixel pixel coordinates and no measured BRIEF descriptors
optical_flow_policy.failure: failed tracking or registration does not renew accepted reference or pose clock; original age expiry and Lost latch unchanged
optical_flow_policy.masks: native RGB grayscale, no additional pixel masks or simulator truth
optical_flow_policy.reference: last accepted measured grayscale image, original detected FAST features, depth image and root pose; current FAST reseeded only when accepted, no long-lived feature identity claim

preprocessing.luma: (77*R+150*G+29*B)>>8; RGB/RGBA8; RGBA must be fully opaque
preprocessing.pixel_coordinates: nearest integer feature coordinate, ties round away from zero
preprocessing.point: centre depth at feature pixel; optical x-right y-down z-forward

timestamps.summary_time_unit: rounded microseconds from source timestamps; qualification gates use unrounded seconds

freeze.qualification_order: source-bound timestamp and row-arity metadata before any image bytes, headers, features or fits; ground-truth pose values only after all fits

refinement_policy.failure: reject without current root output or accepted reference/clock renewal; no coarse-pose fallback
refinement_policy.initial_pose: original previous_from_current robust3D fit, never motion-capture labels
refinement_policy.method: bounded Huber pixel reprojection, maximum8 iterations; convergence and work reported explicitly
refinement_policy.observations: only original robust3D inlier correspondence indices; previous measured depth point and measured current LK subpixel endpoint; fixed support throughout refinement
refinement_policy.pose: refined previous_from_current pose is composed into accepted root; coarse fit and pose are separate diagnostics

tracking_policy.pose: reference-root pose composed with measured refined previous_from_current pixel-reprojection pose
tracking_policy.reference: last accepted measured grayscale image, original detected FAST features and depth image; initial root identity after measured geometry validation
tracking_policy.rejection: no root output or accepted clock/reference update; repeated/stale RGB timestamp versus last observed image rejects, including previously rejected fits; observed image clock advances without permission renewal; accepted-pose expiry checked before RGB freshness; evaluation never resets

limits: All selected images are previously viewed; pyramidal tracking is a viewed calibration variant, not a fresh generalization trial.
Bounded short indoor RGB-D odometry without scale-invariant descriptors, loop closure, global relocalization or driving fusion.
No calibrated covariance or accumulated root confidence; rejected and unscorable frames stay in the denominator.
Pinned published pinhole camera profiles, without physical infrared extrinsics, vehicle calibration or additional pixel undistortion.
